in_sanskrit.name: Ganu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Knowledgeable, Wise
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ganu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Ganu is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘ganana’ which means ‘to count’. The name is associated with knowledge, wisdom, and intelligence. In Hindu mythology, Ganu is a name given to various deities and sages. It is also a common name among Marathi speaking communities.
